p: Shouldest thou help the ungodly: He declares that the wrath of God is over everyone who supports the wicked and does not show in their actions that they are enemies to everyone that hates the Lord.
through the people from Beersheba to: He visited all his country and brought his people from idolatry to the knowledge of the true God.
with you in the judgment: Both to preserve you if you do justly or to punish you, if you do the contrary.
iniquity with the LORD our God: He will declare by the sharpness of the punishment that he hates all iniquity.
returned to Jerusalem: The priests and Levites who should judge matters according to the word of the Lord.
blood and blood: That is, to decide whether or not the murder was done on purpose, Nu 35:11,De 4:41.
wrath come upon you: Meaning, that God would punish them most sharply if they would not execute justice correctly.
king's matters: Shall be chief overseer of the public affairs of the realm.
before you: They will have the handling of inferior causes.
good: God will assist them that do justice.
